```{r}
#pull data
border <- terra::vect(("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Border/border.shp"))
border <- terra::project(border, "epsg:4326")
border_ext <-ext(border)
DEM50 <-  terra::rast("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/DEM rasters/DEM_50cm.tif") %>%
  terra::project("epsg:4326") %>%
  terra::crop(border_ext) %>%
  terra::mask(border)
geomorphons <- terra::rast("../Data/DEM50_rasters/Geomorphons.tif")
twi <- terra::rast("../Data/DEM50_rasters/Topographic Wetness Index.tif")
#observe gap:
na_cells <- is.na(DEM50)
plot(na_cells, col = c(NA, "blue"), legend = FALSE, 
     main = "NA Cells in DEM")

#fill:
window <- matrix(1, nrow = 21, ncol = 21)

# Create a version where NA cells are replaced with the mean of neighbors
dem_filled <- focal(DEM50, w = window, fun = mean, na.policy = 'only', na.rm = TRUE)

# Copy the original DEM
dem_final <- DEM50

# Replace only the NA cells in the original with the interpolated ones
values(dem_final)[is.na(values(DEM50))] <- values(dem_filled)[is.na(values(DEM50))]

plot(DEM50, main = "Original DEM with Hole")
#crop by border again:
dem_final <- terra::mask(dem_final, border)
plot(dem_final, main = "DEM with Hole Filled")

terra::writeRaster(dem_final, "../Output/dem_filled.tif", overwrite = TRUE)


#reproject
ref_raster <- dem_final  # or whichever covariate you want to match
deg_per_25m <- 25 / 111320  # ≈ 0.0002246 degrees

template25 <- rast(
  extent = ext(ref_raster),   # exact extent to match
  resolution = deg_per_25m,   # 25m in degrees
  crs = crs(ref_raster)       # same CRS as your covariates
)

dem_25m <- resample(dem_final, template25, method = "bilinear")
# ext(dem_25m) <- ext(ref_raster)  # Ensure extent matches template
terra::writeRaster(dem_25m, "../Data/resamples/dem_25m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

# # To check:
res(dem_25m)
crs(dem_25m)
ext(dem_final)

#resample to 1m DEM:
# Create a template raster for 1m resolution
deg_per_1m <- 1 / 111320
template1 <- rast(
  extent = ext(ref_raster),   # exact extent to match
  resolution = deg_per_1m,    # 1m in degrees
  crs = crs(ref_raster)       # same CRS as your covariates
)
dem_1m <- resample(dem_final, template1, method = "bilinear")
terra::writeRaster(dem_1m, "../Data/resamples/dem_1m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

#resample to 3m:
deg_per_3m <- 3 / 111320
template3 <- rast(
  extent = ext(ref_raster),   # exact extent to match
  resolution = deg_per_3m,    # 3m in degrees
  crs = crs(ref_raster)       # same CRS as your covariates
)
dem_3m <- resample(dem_final, template3, method = "bilinear")
terra::writeRaster(dem_3m, "../Data/resamples/dem_3m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r load saga tifs}
#50cm:
dem50_files <- list.files("../Data/DEM50_rasters/", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

dem50_rasters <- lapply(dem50_files, terra::rast)
names(dem50_rasters) <- gsub("\\.tif$", "", basename(dem50_files))

dem_stack <- rast(dem50_rasters)

#25m:

dem25_stack <- rast(dem25_rasters)
```

```{r load soil data}
#load soil data:
soil_data <- read.csv("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/soil_points.csv") 

#find variable importance of dem50_rasters (with the soil data used for variable importance being columns being LBC, pH, Ca, K, Mg, Mn, P, and Zn)
soil_data <- soil_data %>%
  select(ID, LBC.1, pH.2, Ca, K, Mg, Mn, P, Zn, x, y)
# Extract coords from soil_data:
soil_coords <- soil_data[, c("x", "y")]


covariate_values <- terra::extract(dem_stack,soil_coords)
# Combine with soil data (excluding x, y if present)
model_data <- cbind(soil_data, covariate_values[,-1])  # -1 to drop ID column

library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)

# Ensure column names are valid R names
names(model_data) <- make.names(names(model_data))
soil_vars <- make.names(c("LBC.1", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn"))
covariate_names <- setdiff(names(model_data), c("ID", soil_vars, "x", "y"))

# Check what variables you actually have
print("Soil variable columns in model_data:")
print(soil_vars)
print("Covariate columns in model_data:")
print(covariate_names)

varimp_list <- list()
for (target in soil_vars) {
  # Select only the response and predictor columns, drop NA rows
  this_data <- model_data %>%
    select(all_of(c(target, covariate_names))) %>%
    na.omit()

  # Check for enough data and variability
  if (nrow(this_data) > 5 && length(unique(this_data[[target]])) > 1) {
    formula <- as.formula(paste(target, "~", paste(covariate_names, collapse = "+")))
    rf <- randomForest(formula, data = this_data, importance = TRUE)
    vi <- randomForest::importance(rf)
    if (is.vector(vi)) {
      vi <- t(as.matrix(vi))
      rownames(vi) <- covariate_names
    }
    varimp_list[[target]] <- vi
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping", target, ": insufficient data or no variation"))
    varimp_list[[target]] <- NULL
  }
}

# Combine variable importance results into one summary data frame
varimp_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(varimp_list), function(var) {
  vi <- varimp_list[[var]]
  if (is.null(vi)) return(NULL)
  incmse <- if ("IncMSE" %in% colnames(vi)) vi[, "IncMSE"] else NA
  incnodepurity <- if ("IncNodePurity" %in% colnames(vi)) vi[, "IncNodePurity"] else NA
  data.frame(
    SoilVar = var,
    Covariate = rownames(vi),
    IncMSE = incmse,
    IncNodePurity = incnodepurity
  )
}))

print(varimp_df)
library(dplyr)

top_varimp <- varimp_df %>%
  group_by(SoilVar) %>%
  arrange(desc(IncNodePurity)) %>%
  #get the top 5 in each soil var:
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
print(top_varimp)
```


```{r corr matrix}
# Select only relevant columns
corr_data <- model_data[, c(soil_vars, covariate_names)]

# Remove rows with any NAs
corr_data <- na.omit(corr_data)

# Calculate correlation matrix (will include both soil vars and covariates)
corr_matrix <- cor(corr_data)

# If you want only soil vars vs covariates (not all vs all):
corr_matrix_soil_vs_covariates <- corr_matrix[soil_vars, covariate_names]

library(corrplot)

# Assuming you already have corr_matrix_soil_vs_covariates from previous code
corrplot(corr_matrix_soil_vs_covariates,
         method = 'color',
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45,
         na.label = " ",
         is.corr = FALSE,      # because this is not square
         mar = c(0,0,2,0),
         title = "Correlation: Soil Nutrients vs Covariates")
```
```{r}
soil_points <- vect(soil_data[, c("x", "y")], geom = c("x", "y"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
soil_points_utm <- project(soil_points, dem25_stack) # for 25m rasters

# Extract values from the 50cm stack (already in lon/lat)
vals_50cm <- terra::extract(dem_stack, soil_points)
colnames(vals_50cm) <- paste0("dem50_", colnames(vals_50cm))

# Extract values from the 25m stack (projected points)
vals_25m <- terra::extract(dem25_stack, soil_points_utm)
colnames(vals_25m) <- paste0("dem25_", colnames(vals_25m))

# 2. Combine everything
model_data <- cbind(
  soil_data,
  vals_50cm[,-1], # remove ID col from extract
  vals_25m[,-1]   # remove ID col from extract
)

# 3. Select relevant columns for correlation
soil_vars <- c("LBC.1", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn")
covariate_names_50cm <- colnames(model_data)[grepl("^dem50_", colnames(model_data))]
covariate_names_25m  <- colnames(model_data)[grepl("^dem25_", colnames(model_data))]

corr_data <- model_data[, c(soil_vars, covariate_names_50cm, covariate_names_25m)]
corr_data <- na.omit(corr_data)
corr_matrix <- cor(corr_data)
corr_matrix_soil_vs_covariates <- corr_matrix[soil_vars, c(covariate_names_50cm, covariate_names_25m)]

# 4. Plot
corrplot(corr_matrix_soil_vs_covariates,
         method = 'color',
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.srt = 45,
         na.label = " ",
         is.corr = FALSE,
         mar = c(0,0,2,0),
         title = "Correlation: Soil Nutrients vs Covariates")
```

```{r}

#creation of topographic covariates based on DEM50:
# Slope
slope <- terrain(dem_final, v = "slope")

# Aspect
aspect <- terrain(dem_final, v = "aspect")

# Hillshade
hillshade <- shade(slope, aspect)
#terrain roughness index:
tri <- terrain(dem_final, v = "TRI")
# Topographic Position Index (TPI)
tpi <- terrain(dem_final, v = "TPI")
# profile curvature
profile.crv <- curvature(dem_final, type="profile")
# planform curvature
planform.crv <- curvature(dem_final, type="planform")
# total curvature
total.crv <- curvature(dem_final, type="total")
#terrain ruggedness index:
tri <- terrain(dem_final, v = "TRI")
plot(tri)

#rsagtri#rsaga curvature:
rsaga.profile.curvature(
  in.dem = "dem_filled.tif",
  out.vcurv = "../Data/DEM50_rasters/vprofilecurv.tif",
  #out.hcurv = "../Data/DEM50_rasters/horizontalcurv.tif",
  #out.mcurv = "../Data/DEM50_rasters/meancurv.tif",
  method = "poly2zevenbergen",
  env = saga_env
)

#flow direction:
FLD<- terrain(dem_final,          #  raster DEM
    v="flowdir",             # flow direction
    unit='degrees')                 # unit degree

# spplot(FLD,
#        main= "Flow Direction",
#       col.regions=rgb.palette(100))


#topographic wetness index:
rsaga.wetness.index(
  in.dem = "dem_filled.tif",
  out.wetness = "../Data/DEM50_rasters/topographic_wetness_index.tif",
  env = saga_env
)

```
```{r save covariates}
#save all covariates:
covariates <- c(
  dem_final$DEM_50cm,
  slope,
  aspect,
  hillshade,
  tri,
  tpi,
  profile.crv,
  planform.crv,
  total.crv,
  FLD
)
#save to file:
terra::writeRaster(covariates, "../Data/DEM50_rasters/DEM_covariates_50cm.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
```
